product_metadata.title: Delta Children Milan Upholstered Glider Swivel Rocker Chair, Sweet Grey
features: RELAXING MOTION: Fully upholstered glider features a gentle swivel and glide motion

STYLISH & COMFY DESIGN: Seat back features a square tufted pattern | Tonal welt trim | Fashionable design allows the glider to transition from the nursery to the living room | Armrests are thickly padded for comfort
BUILT TO LAST: Sturdy frame providing stability | Durable steel mechanisms to ensure quiet movements
EASY TO CLEAN: Seat cushion is plush, durable and removable for easy cleaning
description: Transform any corner of your nursery into the ultimate escape with the Milan Upholstered Glider Swivel Rocker Chair from Delta Children. A modern take on a classic wingback silhouette, the Milan Glider boasts contemporary accents like sleek arms, a tufted back and tonal welt trim. As cozy as it is beautiful, it swivels and glides, so you can feed, calm or bond with your baby in total comfort. Built to stand the test of time, the Milan Upholstered Glider Swivel Rocker Chair from Delta Children sits above a sturdy frame that's tested to ensure its durability. Plus, its contemporary look goes from the nursery to the living room with ease. Delta Children was founded around the idea of making safe, high-quality children's furniture affordable for all families. They know there's nothing more important than safety when it comes to your child's space. That's why all Delta Children products are built with long-lasting materials to ensure they stand up to years of jumping and playing. Plus, they are rigorously tested to meet or exceed all industry safety standards.
